Click here to learn more. do you have any questions? FAQs Is Global Charity Jobs a recruitment agency? No, Global Charity Jobs is a leading international jobs board that connects non-profit organisations with experienced professionals from all over the world. However, Global Charity Jobs is developed by Upsall International, a global consulting and recruitment agency serving the non-proﬁt community worldwide. Please visit upsallinternational.com if you would like to find out more or explore further recruitment services. I do not have a visa to work in the country I wish to apply for a position. Can I apply? Unless the information in the job description states otherwise, you should be able to apply for any of the roles on Global Charity Jobs. We recommend that you carefully read the job description and make sure that your skills, qualifications and experience match those required by the recruiting organisation. If you have any queries, contact the advertising organisation and they will be able to advise you further. What is the scope of Global Charity Jobs? For over 20 years, we have served more than 900 clients from all continents, from recognized major international non-profit organisations such as Greenpeace, Save the Children, or UNHCR, as well as numerous smaller and national start-ups. If you are a candidate looking for an international career, non-profit organisations are hiring global talent to work in flexible, remote, or hybrid roles and we can put you on their radar. Our range of opportunities is massive: from fundraising, marketing, communication, digital, IT, business development, strategic planning, leadership and more. Who uploads the job on Global Charity Jobs? Non-profit organisations will handle this task. We have prepared our website to be very user-friendly and it’s simple and easy to use. Once registered, you can access your account at any time and submit your job. If you experienc any problem during the process, just drop a line and we will get back to you for more support. Damit schaffst Du eine wichtige Grundlage dafür, dass der Ökolöwe e.V. handlungsfähig, abrechnungsfähig und prüffähig bleibt. Als Leipziger Umweltschutzverein kämpft der Ökolöwe seit 1989 mit Appellen, Kampagnen und Projekten für starken Umweltschutz und eine nachhaltige Stadtentwicklung in Leipzig.Um den Schutz der Umwelt, der Natur, der Lebensgrundlagen – kurzum: die Lebensqualität in der Stadt – nachhaltig voranzutreiben, werden alternative Ideen und Konzepte erarbeitet, die sowohl die Stadtgesellschaft mobilisieren als auch Politik und Verwaltung beraten und hinterfragen.Dabei richtet sich das Hauptaugenmerk vor allem auf die Handlungsfelder Umwelt- & Naturschutz, nachhaltige Stadtentwicklung, Klimakrise und Mobilitätswende. Hier setzt der Ökolöwe inhaltlich an, um fachlich fundiert und öffentlichkeitswirksam für mehr Stadtgrün, die Revitalisierung der Leipziger Auenlandschaft, wirksamen Artenschutz, zusätzliche Rad- und Fußwege sowie für besseren und bezahlbaren Nahverkehr zu kämpfen – stets mit der Vision vor Augen, Leipzig in eine klimapositive Stadt zu verwandeln, die für heutige und kommende Generationen ein lebenswertes Zuhause bietet.Veranstaltungen und Projekte wie das Leipziger Stadtradeln, die Umwelttage, die Ökofete, der Stadtgarten Connewitz und die Umweltbibliothek vervollständigen und ergänzen die umweltpolitische Arbeit des Ökolöwen. Sie inspirieren die Leipziger:innen zu einer nachhaltigen und ressourcenschonenden Lebensweise.Für ein lebenswertes Leipzig werden wir kreativ und kämpfen engagiert und hartnäckig:• Für mehr Grün in Leipzig: von neuen Straßenbäumen über blühende Baumscheiben bis Fassadengrün• Für einen artenreichen und gesunden Auwald• Gegen Motorboote auf Leipzigs Gewässern• Für die Mobilitätswende• Für bezahlbaren Nahverkehr• Für mehr und sichere Rad- und Fußwege• Für ein nachhaltiges Leben in Leipzig Hauptsitz Bernhard-Göring-Straße 152 04277 Leipzig Website besuchen Nachhaltigkeitsziele Umwelt schützen Förderung von Tier- und Pflanzenschutz Wir fördern eine tier- und pflanzenfreundliche Welt: Deshalb setzen wir uns für ihren Schutz ein und ergreifen Maßnahmen, um ihre Lebensräume zu erhalten sowie neue zu schaffen. Wir verhindern Monokulturen und Giftstoffe und wollen die Biodiversität der Pflanzen stärken, um unsere natürliche Atmosphäre zu schützen oder wiederherzustellen. Wissen vermitteln Aufklärung über gesellschafts- und umweltrelevante Themengebiete Wir sehen unsere Aufgabe darin, Informationen für die Masse zugänglich zu machen und wollen die Menschen über aktuelle Situationen in der Welt aufklären oder auf Handlungsmöglichkeiten hinweisen. Gute Bikes baut man nicht allein – dafür braucht es ein starkes Team! Und genau das haben wir: fahrradbegeisterte Menschen, die an Städte mit weniger Autos und mehr Lebensqualität glauben. muli ist mehr als nur ein Lastenrad-Unternehmen. Wir sind ein Ort, an dem Solidarität zählt und persönliche Entwicklung möglich ist. Faire Löhne, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Familienfreundlichkeit sind für uns keine Extras, sondern Standard. Die muli Factory ist ein dynamischer Ort: Wir entwickeln, bauen, tüfteln. Wir bedienen Maschinen, arbeiten mit unseren Händen und leben unsere Werte. Hier entstehen unsere Räder und unsere Botschaften – und gehen von Köln aus in die Welt. Und jetzt kommst du ins Spiel:Als People Operations Support arbeitest du eng mit unserer People & Culture Managerin zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass bei uns administrativ alles rund läuft. Wir suchen eine Person, die uns mit ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kann.Deine AufgabenAdministration: Du verantwortest unsere People & Culture-Administration entlang des gesamten Employee-Lifecycle und erstellst dabei alle relevanten Dokumente – vom Onboarding bis zum Offboarding.Fristen & Sorgfalt: Du behältst alle wichtigen Fristen und Workflows in unserem System im Blick, ob Probezeit, Elternzeit oder befristete Verträge und denkst proaktiv mit, damit nichts durchrutscht.Daten & Payroll-Schnittstelle: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Daten und Ablagen immer sauber und aktuell sind, lieferst alle abrechnungsrelevanten Infos rechtzeitig und bist die verlässliche Schnittstelle zu unserem Steuerberater für das Thema Lohn.Recruiting: Bei Bedarf unterstützt du im Recruiting – durch Terminkoordination, Kommunikation mit Kandidat:innen und den kontinuierlichen Aufbau unseres Kandidat:innenpools.Prozesse & Digitalisierung: Du bringst dich aktiv ein, wenn es darum geht, unsere People-Prozesse einfacher, schlanker und digitaler zu machen.Arbeitssicherheit: Du behältst die Themen rund um Arbeitssicherheit im Blick und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Arbeitssicherheitsbeauftragten sowie externen Partner:innen zusammen. qualifications: Das solltest du mitbringenDu bringst eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit und hast bereits erste Erfahrung in der Personalsachbearbeitung gesammelt. Genauso wichtig ist uns aber, wie du arbeitest:Struktur & Übersicht: Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei vielen Fristen, sensiblen Infos und wiederkehrenden Aufgaben den Überblick.Service- und Teamorientierung: Du hast Lust, anderen den Rücken freizuhalten, kommunizierst klar und bist eine verlässliche Anlaufstelle für Kolleg:innen.Vertrauenswürdigkeit & Diskretion: Du gehst sicher und verantwortungsvoll mit vertraulichen Informationen um und weißt, dass Personalarbeit auf Vertrauen basiert.Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst gerne mit an, bringst eigene Ideen ein und hast Freude daran, Prozesse gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.Kommunikation & Empathie: Du kommunizierst gerne mit unterschiedlichen Menschen, hörst zu und findest auch bei kleinen oder sensiblen Anliegen die richtige Balance aus Serviceorientierung und Professionalität.Digitale Affinität: Du fühlst dich in MS Office zuhause, HR-Tools wie Personio, Leapsome oder Workday sind dir nicht fremd (oder du lernst sie gerne dazu). further_information: Das erwartet dich bei muliEin Job mit Sinn: Nachhaltigkeit, Qualität und Fairness sind Werte, die uns im Alltag leiten.Ein Team mit Haltung und Herz: Wir arbeiten an einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen, Transparenz und Miteinander basiert. Dabei sind wir noch nicht perfekt – aber ehrlich, lernbereit und immer offen für gute Ideen. job_description:

\n

Wir sind muli cycles!\u202f

Gute Bikes baut man nicht allein \u2013 daf\u00fcr braucht es ein starkes Team! Und genau das haben wir: fahrradbegeisterte Menschen, die an St\u00e4dte mit weniger Autos und mehr Lebensqualit\u00e4t glauben. muli ist mehr als nur ein Lastenrad-Unternehmen. Wir sind ein Ort, an dem Solidarit\u00e4t z\u00e4hlt und pers\u00f6nliche Entwicklung m\u00f6glich ist. Faire L\u00f6hne, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Familienfreundlichkeit sind f\u00fcr uns keine Extras, sondern Standard. Die muli Factory ist ein dynamischer Ort: Wir entwickeln, bauen, t\u00fcfteln. Wir bedienen Maschinen, arbeiten mit unseren H\u00e4nden und leben unsere Werte. Hier entstehen unsere R\u00e4der und unsere Botschaften \u2013 und gehen von K\u00f6ln aus in die Welt.\u00a0

Und jetzt kommst du ins Spiel:
Als People Operations Support arbeitest du eng mit unserer People & Culture Managerin zusammen und sorgst daf\u00fcr, dass bei uns administrativ alles rund l\u00e4uft. Wir suchen eine Person, die uns mit ca.\u00a020 Stunden pro Woche unterst\u00fctzen kann.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Administration:\u00a0Du verantwortest unsere People & Culture-Administration entlang des gesamten Employee-Lifecycle und erstellst dabei alle relevanten Dokumente \u2013 vom Onboarding bis zum Offboarding.
  • Fristen & Sorgfalt: Du beh\u00e4ltst alle wichtigen Fristen und Workflows in unserem System im Blick, ob Probezeit, Elternzeit oder befristete Vertr\u00e4ge und denkst proaktiv mit, damit nichts durchrutscht.
  • Daten & Payroll-Schnittstelle: Du sorgst daf\u00fcr, dass unsere Daten und Ablagen immer sauber und aktuell sind, lieferst alle abrechnungsrelevanten Infos rechtzeitig und bist die verl\u00e4ssliche Schnittstelle zu unserem Steuerberater f\u00fcr das Thema Lohn.
  • Recruiting: Bei Bedarf unterst\u00fctzt du im Recruiting \u2013 durch Terminkoordination, Kommunikation mit Kandidat:innen und den kontinuierlichen Aufbau unseres Kandidat:innenpools.
  • Prozesse & Digitalisierung: Du bringst dich aktiv ein, wenn es darum geht, unsere People-Prozesse einfacher, schlanker und digitaler zu machen.
  • Arbeitssicherheit:\u00a0Du beh\u00e4ltst die Themen rund um Arbeitssicherheit im Blick und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Arbeitssicherheitsbeauftragten sowie externen Partner:innen zusammen.

qualifications:

{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Stakeholder Engagement Support","description":"

Contract Type: Consultancy

Contract Duration: From Mid August 2026 to 30 November 2026

Deadline to Submit a Candidacy: 7 August 2026, 11:59 PM CEST

CGIAR is seeking an experienced individual consultant or firm (hereafter “Consultant”) to provide targeted and time-bound coordination and facilitation support on stakeholder engagement as part of the development of CGIAR’s 2040 Strategy. The Consultant will work under the oversight of the CGIAR Strategy Task Team and its Work Stream 5 on Stakeholder Engagement to ensure strong stakeholder ownership of, commitment to, and support for the Strategy.

Background and context

CGIAR has embarked on a process to develop a comprehensive Strategy to 2040. Guided by the overarching question: “What do we want CGIAR to become?”; the proposed CGIAR Strategy drives clarity and alignment on CGIAR’s mission, vision, and strategic priorities to the year 2040. The Strategy aims to reposition CGIAR for greater relevance, effectiveness, and impact in a changing global context; and articulate CGIAR’s forward-looking value proposition and comparative advantage. The CGIAR Strategy is developed under the oversight of the CGIAR Board, the leadership of the CGIAR Executive Managing Director, and the guidance of CGIAR’s partnership-wide Global Leadership Team (GLT). A CGIAR Strategy Task Team, comprising representatives of all CGIAR Centers and the CGIAR System Organization, is responsible for the development of the Strategy through a transparent and inclusive co-design process.

In support of its Work Stream 5 on Stakeholder Engagement, the CGIAR Strategy Task Team seeks the Consultant to contribute towards an inclusive identification of stakeholder priorities, expectations, and perceptions; a deeper understanding of CGIAR’s real and perceived strategic positioning and comparative advantage; areas of convergence and divergence across different stakeholders and stakeholder groups; and a preliminary identification of continent- and region-specific interests that can inform future regional/continental strategies to operationalize the overarching CGIAR 2040 Strategy.

\n

Requirements

Scope of Work

Working under the oversight and guidance of the CGIAR Strategy Task Team and its Work Stream 5 on Stakeholder Engagement, the Consultant will:

• Stakeholder engagement planning: refine the Task Team’s stakeholder engagement plan, including stakeholder mapping and engagement methods.

• Stakeholder survey: design, implement, and analyze and summarize the results of a broad-based stakeholder survey in support of the CGIAR Strategy.

• Key stakeholder interviews: conduct 50–60 semi-structured key stakeholder interviews (CGIAR leadership, Board members, Council members, partners) and analyze and summarize relevant insights.

• Consultation meetings: organize, facilitate, and capture the outcomes of targeted virtual and in-person stakeholder meetings.

• Final report: across the key responsibilities above, prepare a final report that translates findings into actionable, strategic insights as an input to the Task Team’s Synthesis Report (by early October 2026).

Deliverables

• Refined stakeholder engagement plan, including stakeholder mapping and engagement methods.

• Stakeholder survey instrument, implementation, and analysis with summary of results.

• Summary of key insights from 50–60 semi-structured stakeholder interviews.

• Outcomes of targeted virtual and in-person consultation meetings.

• Final report translating findings into actionable, strategic insights as an input to the Task Team’s Synthesis Report (by early October 2026).

Timeline

The process to develop the CGIAR Strategy to 2040 is set out in the following broad phases:

• June–early November 2026: analytical work and stakeholder engagement culminating in a Synthesis Report by the Strategy Task Team and broad-based Stakeholder Workshop in early November.

• November 2026–January 2027: stakeholder review and iteration of a complete draft Strategy.

• January–February 2027: CGIAR Leadership and governance-level reviews and decision-making on an intended final version of the Strategy.

• March 2027: Launch, roll-out.

Consultant Profile

The Consultant will demonstrate strong experience and expertise in the following areas:

• Multistakeholder engagement design, planning, and delivery in an international science, innovation, and/or development setting.

• Convening and facilitation.

• Quantitative and qualitative survey design and analysis.

• Strategic communication and diplomacy.

• Strategy design and development.

A deep understanding of and familiarity with CGIAR’s stakeholder environment and work on science and innovations to transform food, land, and water systems is desirable.

Evaluation Criteria

• Quality and relevance of experience and expertise.

• Value for money.

• Ability to deliver within the proposed timeline.

To Submit a Proposal

Candidates will submit:

• A short profile (for individuals) or company profile (for firms) demonstrating relevant experience and qualifications.

• A concise technical proposal outlining approach and delivery steps within the proposed timeframe.

• A simple budget proposal outlining the proposed number of working days and the Consultant’s daily rate, with costs broken down by deliverable.

\n

Benefits

All applications must be submitted online by clicking the 'Apply' button below before 11:59 PM CET on 07 August 2026.

If you require assistance or face challenges in submitting your application, please email smo-bidding@cgiar.org with the position title in the subject line. Applications submitted through smo-bidding@cgiar.org will NOT be accepted.

Please ensure your resume and cover letter are in English and does not contain your marital status, age, or photograph. Documents provided in a language other than English will not be considered.

CGIAR is committed to fair, safe, and inclusive workplaces. We believe that diversity powers our innovation, contributes to our excellence, and is critical for our mission. We offer a multi-cultural, multi-color, multi-generational, and multi-disciplinary, collegial working environment. We consciously create an inclusive organization that reflects our global character and commitment to gender equity. We, therefore, encourage applicants from all cultures, races, ethnicities, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientations, and gender identities.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

content.Title: What if it all goes right? - by Anne Marie Kingsland
content.MainContent: What if it all goes right?We bet our company on AI. Here’s the case for optimism.Anne Marie KingslandJun 29, 20267ShareIn 2022, Intercom (now Fin) faced a reckoning. Five consecutive quarters of declining revenue growth required serious action. Our founding CEO Eoghan returned with a five-point plan, we refocused our efforts around a single product category, and underwent a reduction in force. And then, ChatGPT arrived. Our co-founder Des Traynor wondered if the emergence of AI was “adding insult to injury, or the single scenario that we can’t survive?”All around us, SaaS companies were getting “sold off for parts to private equity.” The end seemed near.But after a weekend of experimenting with the newly released LLM, the future appeared less bleak than initially forecast. As Des put it: “AI might actually be both the death of our company and also the best chance we have of survival.”By Monday, we decided to go all in, and over the next three years we rebuilt almost everything we’d spent the previous eleven years building, including the name.Des recently talked through how that happened – on The Further, Faster Podcast and the AI Revolution Show. What follows pulls the two conversations together: the entrepreneurial lessons learned along the way, what to consider when undergoing your own AI pivot, and why Des thinks we’ve grown too pessimistic about the AI-powered future.Focus on the product in front of youBefore the AI story, there’s the unglamorous part that made it possible. On The Further, Faster Podcast, Des walks us through it and what he thinks today’s entrepreneurs should focus on.Firstly, the job of a founder is “to do something that doesn’t make sense up until the point that it does make sense” – and the moment it makes sense, the founder phase is over and you’re running a business. Des feels it’s not good to idolize or obsess over the label of founder because it should be a temporary role; don’t cling to it rather than admitting your company has stopped working. The entrepreneurs he’d back again are the ones who “closed their business down, gave the money back, took a couple of years working in a good company, got some new ideas, and went again.”That’s also why he’s wary of early-stage companies chasing investment capital. “A really long runway is not what you should be optimizing for. You should be optimizing for success.” Chase the valuation and you end up watching your own stock price instead of asking the only questions that matter: “are we building good software? Do people like it? Are they paying a good amount of money for it?”You can feel the difference in the products themselves. Des refers to the experience of building Exceptional – an error-tracking tool the team developed before Intercom – as “doing your best to try and push it up a hill”. Intercom was the opposite: it “was a very easy product to bring out,” viral in the way B2B occasionally is. Early users routinely praised it, even just a few months in.This is why it’s important to ship. Founders often delay launching because they’re afraid to find out their product doesn’t work, and a reputation as a “considerate, tasteful founder” is a comfortable disguise for that fear. After you ship, take user feedback seriously but not blindly. When they ask for 11 more features, don’t assume they’re right – “that could be their way of saying this is a bag of shit.”Becoming an AI company takes sacrificeThe decision to go all in on AI was, oddly, the easy part. It was clear, customer service was about to be changed completely, and it was a race against the clock to be the first to market.The hard part was everything after the decision. A transformation like this touches the whole company – the branding, the pricing, what you sell, how you build, and who you compete with. On the AI Revolution Show, Des compares it to the ship of Theseus: change enough of the parts and it’s hard to say what’s still the original boat. “Maybe the canteen is the same,” he joked.What made that survivable was culture set deliberately, in advance. When Eoghan returned and rewrote the company values, three of them – resilience, open-mindedness, and impatience – read, in hindsight, like preparation for exactly this. So when we made radical decisions like breaking up teams or abandoning roadmaps, the ground had already been laid.For companies going through change, Des also warns not to “be a prisoner of nostalgia.” Intercom was a longstanding, beloved brand. On the surface, sacrificing it looks like a significant risk. But he argues the opposite. “Being known isn’t always useful – it can almost be a counterweight.”He tested this theory with a thought experiment: “If I said the coolest new payroll app is built by Workday, you’d be like, really?” The name you’ve spent a decade building can be the very thing that stops people believing you’re building something new, so you have to be willing to “shred and shed that brand legacy.”Building and selling the AI-native wayPlenty of products call themselves AI-native. Most fail the first test: does the product work? Customer support is load-bearing – if it breaks, the business breaks – so “it works most of the time” isn’t good enough.Clearing that bar takes more than a wrapper. We’ve gone down to the model layer with Apex, and what looks from the outside like a single product is, in Des’s words, “more like 27 systems connected together,” several revisions deep.Looks can be deceiving though. It’s common for users to think they can recreate Fin with a frontier model, and maybe they can reach a 30 or 40% resolution rate in two minutes. “The other forty percent is going to take you three years and 60 people.” We watch prospects try to build their own, get stuck, and come back – and sometimes the only useful thing is to let them “bang their head off a brick wall” and leave the door open.Building for AI is different from building software. We used to start with customer research, but because customers aren’t experts in what AI now makes possible, you now have to start with what’s technically reliable and take that to the market. It’s a reversal Des expects to be temporary, until the technology settles.You also have to rethink design. The AI-native instinct isn’t to begin with “boxes and arrows and buttons.” It’s to take the least amount from the user and give back the most. The example Des provides is bug reporting. Rather than relying on users to report issues, a bug should be automatically detected so the experience goes “from seven screens to no screens.”And the impact of all of this must be easily demonstrable. According to Des: “brand will get you the demand, but ultimately performance is what gets you the contract.” Serious buyers run bake-offs – a thousand of their own real questions across three vendors – and we lean into it. Rigour favours whoever is actually best; deliver results and the sales will follow.What if it all goes right?AI is going to keep moving. It’s a realization Des has had to come to terms with: “I’ve probably been more wrong than right whenever I’ve said … I think the AI is settled here.”What does this pace of advancement mean for the wider market? The walls between products will come down – point solutions will be absorbed by whoever owns the rest of the workflow. Des thinks the systems of record will endure, and a smaller number of larger businesses will dominate.It’s reasonable to feel apprehension towards such a mammoth change, it’s a narrative that dominates the media. And overall, the conversation about AI has become fluent in every way it might go wrong. But we’re strangely quiet about the other possibility. “No one’s asking what if it all goes right,” Des says – what it might mean for things like education or healthcare access.The near term will hold real dislocation, and we’re not pretending otherwise. But the upside, he argues, “is potentially the biggest thing we’re ever going to see for humanity.”We’ve already run the small version of that experiment on ourselves. We bet the company, disrupted the thing we’d built, and came out the other side stronger for it. That isn’t proof the larger bet pays off. But it’s reason enough to take the optimistic question seriously – and to keep building as though the answer is yes.Watch or listen to the full conversations: Des Traynor on The Further, Faster Podcast and the AI Revolution Show.7SharePreviousNextDiscussion about this postCommentsRestacksTopLatestDiscussionsNo postsReady for more?Subscribe

{"@context":"http://schema.org","@type":"JobPosting","baseSalary":{"@type":"MonetaryAmount","currency":"","value":{"@type":"QuantitativeValue","unitText":""}},"datePosted":"2026-7-22","description":"

El Regional Account Manager desarrollará relaciones comerciales con líderes de opinión hospitalarios y responsables de la toma de decisiones con el fin de maximizar el acceso a los productos de Alexion en las cuentas clave y hospitales identificados dentro de la región.

Será responsable de:

Principales Funciones

  • Proporcionar información científica y médica sobre los productos (NF1 – Koselugo, LAL-D – Kanuma) a líderes de opinión y responsables de la toma de decisiones.
  • Implementar la estrategia comercial de Alexion en las cuentas clave y hospitales asignados, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.
  • Identificar y comunicar a Alexion las necesidades, el entorno y los requisitos de las cuentas clave.
  • Construir una sólida red de relaciones de confianza con cuentas clave, hospitales, decisores e influenciadores.
  • Implementar planes educativos y de concienciación sobre enfermedades de acuerdo con las directrices y procedimientos establecidos, utilizando materiales y herramientas aprobadas.
  • Garantizar el acceso al tratamiento para todos los pacientes que sean candidatos adecuados.
  • Organizar reuniones formativas con el personal hospitalario, cuando sea necesario, con el apoyo del Departamento Médico.
  • Monitorizar y analizar datos y condiciones del mercado para identificar ventajas competitivas.
  • Mantener actualizado el sistema ETMS y realizar el correspondiente reporte y gestión de la relación con clientes (CRM).
  • Recoger y comunicar información de farmacovigilancia conforme a los procedimientos establecidos por el Departamento Médico.

Función de soporte

  • Compartir toda la información relevante con el equipo de Alexion Pharma en el país.
  • Colaborar de manera transversal con los equipos de Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access y Public Affairs.
  • Participar en la elaboración de la estrategia comercial y de marketing a nivel nacional.
  • Mantenerse informado sobre los cambios en las políticas sanitarias y evaluar su impacto en el negocio de Alexion.
  • Preparar e impartir presentaciones médicas, educativas y promocionales dirigidas a clientes y otros grupos de interés.

Cumplimiento

  • Garantizar que todas las actividades se desarrollen de acuerdo con la normativa farmacéutica vigente, así como con los valores, políticas y procedimientos internos de la compañía.

Requisitos:

  • Preferiblemente, al menos 5 años de experiencia en el entorno hospitalario, especialmente en enfermedades raras (deseable), medicamentos huérfanos, oncología o enfermedades complejas gestionadas de forma multidisciplinar.
  • Experiencia sólida en lanzamientos de productos, preferiblemente en entornos altamente competitivos donde haya sido necesario ganar cuota de mercado con rapidez.
  • Trayectoria de al menos 5 años gestionando cuentas hospitalarias multiespecialidad, con capacidad para interactuar eficazmente con distintos tipos de interlocutores (especialistas, farmacéuticos hospitalarios, gestores, dirección hospitalaria, etc.).
  • Se valorará experiencia o conocimientos en Neurología y Oncología.
  • Experiencia previa gestionando diferentes especialidades médicas dentro de una misma cuenta hospitalaria.
  • Experiencia en gestión de proyectos.
  • Historial demostrable de éxito comercial en posiciones hospitalarias especializadas.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos de alta complejidad científica, idealmente en enfermedades raras y/o oncología, desempeñando un rol comercial de campo con un alto grado de autonomía y capacidad de ejecución.
  • Capacidad para definir prioridades y gestionar eficazmente un territorio amplio y complejo, optimizando el tiempo y los recursos disponibles.
  • Capacidad para resolver problemas y gestionar situaciones complejas de manera eficaz.
  • Conocimiento de la normativa farmacéutica vigente en el país.
  • Nivel fluido de inglés, tanto oral como escrito.
  • Manejo de herramientas de Microsoft Office y sistemas de reporte.
  • Alta disponibilidad para viajar a nivel regional y nacional, especialmente debido a la gestión de un territorio que comprende Madrid, Castilla y León y Canarias, incluyendo desplazamientos con pernocta cuando sea necesario.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos altamente competitivos.
  • Zona de responsabilidad: Madrid, Castilla y León y Canarias.

Se valorará adicionalmente

  • Sólida base científica o médica.
  • Titulación universitaria en Ciencias de la Vida (preferiblemente) o en Administración de Empresas, Marketing o disciplinas afines.

Date Posted

22-jul-2026

Closing Date

11-ago-2026

Alexion provides reasonable accommodations to meet the needs of candidates and employees. Propsteiverband Braunschweiger Land suchteine:n Erzieher:in/Heilerziehungspfleger:in (m/w/d) als Vertretungskraft. Ab sofort | Teilzeit (20 Std./Wo.) | befristet in der Einrichtung/unbefristet im Kita-Verband | Ev.-luth. Kita Schunterarche, Braunschweig-Thune In der Ev.-luth. Kita Schunterarche werden 74 Kindergartenkinder von 3 - 6 Jahren betreut und gefördert. Wir arbeiten nach dem offenen Konzept mit Stammgruppen und in drei individuell gestalteten Funktionsräumen. Dieses Konzept bietet den Kindern die Sicherheit und Geborgenheit einer festen Gruppe mit deren BezugserzieherInnen. Gleichzeitig ermöglicht es den Kindern jeden Tag den Spielort, Spielpartner aus allen Gruppen, die Frühstückszeit innerhalb eines festgelegten Zeitraumes frei zu wählen. Dieses unterstützt die Selbstständigkeit, das Entscheidungsvermögen und die Bewegungsfreude der Kinder. Die Bewegungsförderung ist uns ein besonderes Anliegen. In unserem Bewegungsraum sowie auf unserem großzügigen naturnahen Außengelände haben die Kinder die Möglichkeit unterschiedlichste Erfahrungen zu sammeln. Expand The American LGBTQ+ Museum seeks a Chief of Development who will provide the leadership, direction, and coordination of fundraising strategies and activities to advance the mission of the American LGBTQ+ Museum. Working with a team of three full-time staff and two consultants, the CoD will be responsible for managing all museum fundraising, including campaign fundraising for a $30mm comprehensive campaign, board of directors fundraising, individual major gifts, annual fundraising (direct mail), corporate fundraising and engagement, government fundraising, memberships, all donor communications, and donor cultivation events.The American LGBTQ+ Museum is a bold new institution dedicated to preserving, investigating, and celebrating the dynamic histories and cultures of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer people. The Museum will tell the community’s evolving histories in their own voices as they envision a world in which all people work toward and experience the joy of liberation. Beginning with their incubation at The New York Historical, the Museum will be vibrant and welcoming, both visually and cognitively, for the entire LGBTQ+ community. It will be colorful, lively, immersive, and exploratory, running counter to common conceptions of museums. In addition to an active public space, galleries, programming areas, and amenities, there will also be contemplative spaces. Their partnership with The New York Historical provides 5,000 square feet of gallery space in addition to shared event and educational spaces. Additionally, they will work other partners around the country to produce rotating and traveling exhibitions, public programs, and a robust “virtual museum” to supplement their physical engagements."The Chief of Development has the opportunity to establish the American LGBTQ+ Museum as an anchor institution in New York’s museum landscape and a nationally significant cultural force. content.Title: Lead Food Auditor » Rotterdam, Netherlands
content.MainContent: Lead Food Auditor Location: Rotterdam, Netherlands Business: Business Assurance Position type: Full Time Contract type: Permanent Employee Job ID: 1604 Share Lead Food Auditor Apply Overview About us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About Business Assurance We help companies ensure compliance, build high-performing management systems, and meet competence needs within a wide range of industries. DNV helps companies understand Working with us, you can be involved in technically challenging and innovative projects worldwide demanding a broad variety of expertise. Our strong focus on research and innovation opens an array of opportunities, and allows you to engage in projects which develop next generation solutions. and manage their risk picture through our management system certification and training portfolios. About the role If you enjoy being at the forefront of ensuring food safety, empowering quality assurance teams, and learning through hands-on audits, then we’d like to hear from you! At DNV, we are seeking qualified food auditors to join us in the Netherlands as either full-time employees or freelancers. With experience in the food industry, you already have a food safety certificate (GFSI). What we offer You will examine all aspects of our customers' operations, ensuring transparency and accountability, You will ask the necessary questions to uncover the most accurate and comprehensive information to support food safety compliance, You will build relationships and witness the progress made by our customers in improving their operations and standards. DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity. About you About You:You have work experience as Food Auditor with various food safety schemes, such as BRC, IFS, ISO 22000, FSSC, HACCP and GMP,You have HBO/WO diploma in food area, You have been working in a quality or production position in food industry,You are fluent in Dutch and have good command of English.What we offer:You will benefit from the support that comes from being part of a large and experienced community of auditors,Wide range of benefits: flexible working hours, pension scheme, profit share bonus.Calibration workshops for auditors,Very varied working weeks – your workday is never the same.You are welcome to submit your application! Please note that applications will be accepted only by recruitment system, please use the apply button and submit. Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices Benefits Please note, benefits may depend on your contract type, please confirm with your recruiter. Profit Share You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results. Insurance Taking care of you with travel, life, and accident insurance. Pension Schemes We care about your long-term financial security and prioritize pension and retirement benefits to reflect our caring values. Professional Development We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education. Hybrid Working Adapting to the changing world of work around the world. Purpose-led organization You become part of a world-leading company where we know and live our purpose; to safeguard life, property, and the environment, with the opportunity to tackle global change through your work. Supportive and caring culture We offer opportunities to connect through social and professional networks. Our largest community CONNECT, organizes after-work events and informal meetings throughout the year. Attractive rewards We focus on work/life balance and offer employees flexible working hours and workplace, annual vacation allowance, competitive pension, insurance, and a global profit share scheme. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision. Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values. Learn more Transcript Business Assurance is a unit of DNV where we are working with our customers towards verifying them if they are compliant with some particular rules. We are responsible for scheduling audits. We need to assign the right person with the right competences to conduct such an audit. And we are analysing and improving their processes. But sometimes we need to register some findings like observation, opportunity for improvement, or even non-conformities. I verify our clients' system management by observing them, how they work, how they produce. It's very interesting because we are delivering some additional information for our customers, what they cannot see or discover in their own systems. My work life as an auditor is completely different than employees who are working from the office every day. Because usually I'm travelling to our customers that are located in a different part of our country. Almost every week I work with different people in different companies. So if you like travel, if you are well organized, DNV can be for you. Working here Since 1864 we’ve been dedicated to safeguarding life, property and the environment. Today we remain at the forefront of new technologies and techniques to help our customers transform for a more sustainable future. At DNV you can expect to deliver career and industry defining work. You’ll be given the time to build your network, the resources to support your development, and the freedom to satisfy your curiosity and desire to learn. Learn more Application Process FAQs Welcome to our Frequently Asked Questions page. We’ve put together answers to the questions we’re asked most often to help you find the information you need quickly and easily. Whether you're curious about our recruitment process, benefits or career growth and development, you should find the information below. How can I find job openings that fit my skills and interests? Explore our official job search page where you can use filters such as job type, location, and department to find roles that best match your qualifications and career aspirations. What’s your application process like? You can apply directly through our careers page by submitting your CV and any other documents we require (i.e. university diplomas/transcripts; visas; previous employment reference letters). Make sure your application is fully completed, and you tailor it to the specific job listing. Is your recruitment process designed to be inclusive and accessible? Yes, it is. We're an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all candidates. We’re happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. Share the details of what you need within your application. What types of interviews might I undergo? Depending on your role, our interview process may include initial phone screenings, video conferences, and in-person interviews, focusing on both your technical abilities and our shared values. You can ask your recruiter specifically about the interview process for your role. How long does the hiring process typically take from application to decision? The timeline can vary but we make every effort to reply to each candidate as soon as possible and keep everyone up-to-date with where they are in the recruitment process. How do I know if a recruitment contact is legitimately from your company? Official communication will come from our verified company email addresses. Carefully check any suspicious looking emails and if you have any doubts, don’t engage. Are there any fees involved in your recruitment process? No, we do not charge any fees at any stage of our recruitment process. All applications and interviews are free of charge, we will never ask you to pay any fees or make any payments – please be wary of any requests for payment as these are likely scams. What should I do if I suspect a job scam? If you encounter suspicious job postings or recruitment practices, do not provide personal information and contact your recruiter as soon as possible. We take these matters seriously. We will never ask you to pay any fees or make any payments part of our recruitment process. Do you support candidates who need a visa? This depends on the role. Refer to the job posting for details and make sure you have the necessary permissions or visa to work in the country you’re applying for. We’ll check your documents during the recruitment process and let you know if you’re missing anything. Do you offer relocation services? Depending on the role and location, we may be able to offer support with relocation. Your recruiter will discuss this with you during the recruitment process. What’s your approach to hybrid working? Where will I be based? We’ve adapted to the changing world of work, so depending on your role and location, you'll be able to find a balance between home, on-site and office work that works for you and the business. Will I need to travel for work? Travel requirements vary by role but if you have a field-based role then yes, you will need to travel for work. You’ll find details in the job posting itself and you can ask your recruiter for clarification. What benefits do you offer? We offer a comprehensive benefits package that varies by role and location. We focus on work/life balance and offer you flexible working hours, vacation allowance, competitive pension, insurance and a profit share scheme. You’ll find more details on job postings, and your recruiter can answer any specific questions you have. How much holiday do you offer? Your holiday entitlement depends on your location and length of service. Please take a look at the job posting for more details and speak with your recruiter if you have questions about a specific role’s entitlement. What’s your pension policy? We care about your long-term financial security and prioritize pension and retirement benefits to reflect that. You can ask your recruiter for more information if you have specific questions about our pension policy. What’s your sick leave policy? Your health and wellbeing are our priority, and our policies reflect this. You can find out more about our sick leave policy by talking to your recruiter. What’s your parental leave policy? We understand how important family life is and support parents with leave policies tailored to their needs. If you have specific questions, please ask your recruiter for more details. Do you offer bonuses? You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. You’ll be rewarded as part of our Total Compensation approach each year, which depends on our year-end results. What’s your approach to wellbeing and health insurance? Alongside a healthcare package where you can sign up your spouse and any dependants too, you’ll have access to the many wellbeing initiatives we run, including workshops, webinars, consultations with specialists. What career development opportunities do you offer? We believe in the 70/20/10 approach to learning – on-the-job training, technical development, and formal learning opportunities. You can check out our knowledge booster program video to find out more about how we nurture your growth and development. Do employees return to DNV after leaving? Yes, we regularly welcome back colleagues who have worked elsewhere and then return to us. You can hear one of their stories here. How can I manage my application/data? If you log in to your account on our careers site, you can manage your application and data preferences. Can I sign up for job alerts? Yes, you can register for job alerts by joining our Talent Community here. By signing up, you’ll be first to learn about new job opportunities that could be the perfect fit for you. Join Our Talent Community Can't find the right fit? Be the first one to learn about new job opportunities that might be a perfect fit for you. Join Disclaimer Please beware of recruitment scams that pretend to be from DNV or its employees. We will never ask you to pay any fees or make any payments as part of our recruitment process.

We focus on work/life balance and offer you flexible working hours, vacation allowance, competitive pension, insurance and a profit share scheme. You’ll find more details on job postings, and your recruiter can answer any specific questions you have. How much holiday do you offer? Your holiday entitlement depends on your location and length of service. Please take a look at the job posting for more details and speak with your recruiter if you have questions about a specific role’s entitlement. What’s your pension policy? We care about your long-term financial security and prioritize pension and retirement benefits to reflect that. You can ask your recruiter for more information if you have specific questions about our pension policy. What’s your sick leave policy? Your health and wellbeing are our priority, and our policies reflect this. You can find out more about our sick leave policy by talking to your recruiter. What’s your parental leave policy? We understand how important family life is and support parents with leave policies tailored to their needs. If you have specific questions, please ask your recruiter for more details. Do you offer bonuses? You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. You’ll be rewarded as part of our Total Compensation approach each year, which depends on our year-end results. What’s your approach to wellbeing and health insurance? Alongside a healthcare package where you can sign up your spouse and any dependants too, you’ll have access to the many wellbeing initiatives we run, including workshops, webinars, consultations with specialists. What career development opportunities do you offer? We believe in the 70/20/10 approach to learning – on-the-job training, technical development, and formal learning opportunities. You can check out our knowledge booster program video to find out more about how we nurture your growth and development. Do employees return to DNV after leaving? Yes, we regularly welcome back colleagues who have worked elsewhere and then return to us. You can hear one of their stories here. How can I manage my application/data? If you log in to your account on our careers site, you can manage your application and data preferences. Can I sign up for job alerts? Yes, you can register for job alerts by joining our Talent Community here. By signing up, you’ll be first to learn about new job opportunities that could be the perfect fit for you. Join Our Talent Community Can't find the right fit? Be the first one to learn about new job opportunities that might be a perfect fit for you. Join Disclaimer Please beware of recruitment scams that pretend to be from DNV or its employees. We will never ask you to pay any fees or make any payments as part of our recruitment process.

Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI. With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 300+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone. We seek a highly skilled and motivated Data Operations Specialist to join our data annotation team. In this role, you will support a team of data annotation experts, ensuring the accuracy and reliability of annotated data. This role involves hands-on data annotation and tagging, integrating advanced technologies to streamline data operations, and collaborating with various departments to achieve organizational goals. ﻿A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact: ﻿Perform data annotation and tagging tasks as needed, maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality. Utilize cutting-edge technologies and tools to enhance data operations, improving annotation capabilities and overall project efficiency. Conduct performance reviews of third-party vendors and in-house team members to ensure alignment with project goals and adherence to high-quality standards. Oversee multiple concurrent projects, working collaboratively with various departments to meet project milestones and organizational objectives. Partner with algorithm developers to bridge the gap between labeling concepts and technical constraints, ensuring effective communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Drive continuous improvement in data operations by optimizing workflows, creating automation solutions using Python, and implementing best practices to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort. Exceptional interpersonal skills with a strong ability to build relationships, integrate smoothly into the company culture, and foster team collaboration. Service-oriented mindset with a high level of dedication to supporting both internal teams and external partners. Requirements Proven background of 2+ years in data annotation, data labeling, or QA, with a strong grasp of the field. Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus. Strong written and verbal skills for clearly articulating project needs and for effective cross-departmental collaboration. Methodical with a keen eye for detail, ensuring accuracy and quality in all tasks. Experience in optimizing workflows and creating automation solutions using Python or similar languages. Familiarity with machine learning and deep learning concepts is a plus. Experience with image data and annotations is advantageous. Why UVeye: Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections. Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale. Career Growth Opportunities: Participate in a journey of rapid development, surrounded by groundbreaking advancements and strategic industry partnerships. content.Title: Ausbildung zur/zum Verwaltungsfachangestellten (w/m/d) - Jobs beim Landkreis Lüneburg
content.MainContent: Ausbildung zur/zum Verwaltungsfachangestellten (w/m/d) Du möchtest etwas bewegen, Verantwortung übernehmen und einen Beruf mit Zukunft erlernen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du viele spannende Bereiche kennen – von Umwelt und Soziales über Bauen und Gesundheit bis hin zu Finanzen oder Personal. Freu dich auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv das Leben in unserer Region mitzugestalten. Direkt bewerben Vollzeit befristet bis 31.07.2030 21335 Lüneburg 01.08.2027 Was dich während der Ausbildung erwartet: du durchläufst verschiedene Praxisbereiche in den vier großen Fachbereichen der Kommunalverwaltung des Landkreises Lüneburg, um dir so einen guten Überblick über die Kreisverwaltung verschaffen zu können, das theoretische Wissen wird dir in unterschiedlichen Lehrgängen des Niedersächsischen Studieninstitutes (Einführungs-, Zwischen- und Abschlusslehrgang) vermittelt; die Lehrgängefinden in Lüneburg statt, zudem besuchst du den Berufsschulunterricht an der Berufsbildenden Schule I in Lüneburg, welcher blockweise mehrere Wochen am Stück organisiert ist (insgesamt drei Blockphasen), weitere Informationen zur Ausbildung findest du in unserem Karriereportal (www.landkreis-lueneburg.de/ausbildung). Unsere Erwartungen an dich: du verfügst über einen Sekundarabschluss I und bist motiviert, Neues zu lernen sowie deine Ausbildung und den Praxisalltag aktiv mitzugestalten, spannende Aufgaben rund um Recht, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft wecken dein Interesse und mit deiner sorgfältigen und zuverlässigen Art packst du Aufgaben gern an, im Team fühlst du dich wohl, bringst deine Ideen ein und suchst gemeinsam nach den besten Lösungen, der Kontakt mit Menschen macht dir Freude, du gehst offen auf andere zu und möchtest Bürgerinnen und Bürger unterstützen. Gehalt: Im ersten Ausbildungsjahr erhälst du eine monatliche Vergütung in Höhe von aktuell 1.368,26 €. Wir unterstützen Vielfalt, Offenheit und gegenseitigen Respekt. Deswegen freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen aller Interessierten – unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Religionszugehörigkeit, sexueller Identität, Geschlechteridentität oder einer Behinderung. Bei gleicher Eignung wird bei der Besetzung freier Stellen auf die gleichwertige Repräsentation aller Geschlechter geachtet. Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung bis zum 27.09.2026 unter Angabe des Kennzeichens 30.10/A/01/2026 über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal https://bewerbung.landkreis-lueneburg.de Bitte beachte, dass die Stellenausschreibung nach Ablauf der Bewerbungsfrist nicht länger online verfügbar sein wird. Eine Druckversion der Ausschreibung im PDF-Format findest du hier. 1 JaninaJähnAusbildungsleitung / PersonalgewinnungIch beant­worte alle Fra­gen zur Aus­bil­dung & zum Auswahlver­fahren.04131 26-1673janina.jaehn@landkreis-lueneburg.de

Was wir Dir bieten

  1. Wir machen Dich fit für den Beruf wie kaum ein anderer, denn unsere Azubis schließen laut IHK-Index überdurchschnittlich gut ab, und bieten Dir eine hohe Chance auf Übernahme, sodass Du Dein Potenzial auch langfristig einbringen kannst, sowie neben großzügigen und modernen Büroräumen, flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Kommunikation auch ein hoch motiviertes Team, mit dem Du zusammen lernen, arbeiten und über Dich hinauswachsen wirst.
  2. Zudem kannst Du Dich auf folgende Benefits freuen:
  3. Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Obst & Getränke zum freien Verzehr, Fahrrad-Leasing, Fitnesstraining & Physioanwendungen
  4. Sicherheit & Zukunft: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, eine Unfallversicherung für alle Mitarbeitenden, die auch im privaten Umfeld greift, Zuschuss zu Kitakosten, Englischkurse & Fortbildungen
  5. Gemeinschaft & Freizeit: Mitarbeiterrabatte & abwechslungsreiche Teamevents

Woran Du mit uns arbeitest

  1. Du lernst von Grund auf, wie Marketing funktioniert – von der Idee bis zur operativen Umsetzung.
  2. Du planst zusammen mit Deinem Team interne und externe Events, bereitest diese vor und bist auch vor Ort dabei.
  3. Du erstellst unter Berücksichtigung der aktuellen Trends selbstständig Content für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle und wirkst sowohl vor als auch hinter der Kamera mit.
  4. Du lernst, mit den Adobe-Programmen Deine Ideen direkt umzusetzen, beispielsweise durch das Setzen von Texten und Erstellen von Grafiken.
  5. Du schreibst Texte für unsere Kommunikationskanäle, die unsere Zielgruppe begeistern.

Womit Du uns überzeugst

  1. Mit Deiner Mittleren Reife oder Deinem (Fach-)Abitur sowie idealerweise Deiner ersten Praxiserfahrung, z. B. im Rahmen eines Schulpraktikums,
  2. Deinen ersten Kompetenzen im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen sowie Deinen sicheren Deutsch- (mind. C1) und guten Englischkenntnissen (mind. B1) in Wort und Schrift,
  3. Deiner Leidenschaft für Digitalisierung, die Du gerne an andere weitergibst, sowie Deiner Fähigkeit vor Menschen zu sprechen,
  4. Deinem hohen Maß an Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie Deiner offenen Art, mit der es Dir leichtfällt, Kontakte zu knüpfen,
  5. Deiner Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands, sofern Bedarf besteht.

Wenn wir Dein Interesse geweckt haben…

... dann werde Teil von OPTIMAL SYSTEMS und enaio®– unserer Enterprise All-in-One Solution.
Wir freuen uns auf Deine E-Mail-Bewerbung.

Dein Ansprechpartner in Dortmund

Fabian Suttrop - Inside Sales Assistant

content.Title: Elektroniker für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik als Haustechniker (m/w/d) Stellendetails | hpcgermany
content.MainContent: Nach Stichwort suchen Mehr Optionen anzeigen Laden... Kategorie Alle Erfahrung Alle Vollzeit/Teilzeit Alle Löschen Jetzt bewerben » Das HPI ist eines der führenden universitären Informatikinstitute, (www.hpi.de). Unser Ziel ist es,die digitale Souveränität Europas mit exzellenter Forschung und praxisnaher Lehre in derInformatik zu stärken.Am HPI sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Exzellenz dann entsteht, wenn wir das Wissenverschiedener Disziplinen in Zusammenarbeit verbinden, um gemeinsam verantwortungsvolleund richtungsweisende Lösungen für die Zukunft zu gestalten.In unseren Research Clustern "Systems", "Data and AI", "Foundations", "Digital Health", "Security" und "Business and Society" arbeiten Forschende aus mehreren Fachgebieten gemeinsam an Fragen, die zurLösung gesellschaftlicher Herausforderung beitragen. Die Digital-Engineering-Fakultät derUniversität Potsdam und des HPI bietet ein deutschlandweit einmaliges ingenieurwissenschaftliches Informatikstudium an. Das Hasso-Plattner-Institut sucht im Zuge seines starken Wachstums zum nächstmöglichenZeitpunkt am Standort Potsdam einen Elektroniker für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik als Haustechniker (m/w/d) Die Stelle ist unbefristet und in Vollzeit zu besetzen. ​Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben in der Haustechnik Durchführung von Elektroinstallationen und -modifikationen gemäß geltender Vorschriften Analyse und Behebung von Störungen in den elektrischen Anlagen sowie proaktive Fehlersuche Dokumentation aller durchgeführten Arbeiten und Meldung von notwendigen Reparaturen oder Ersatzbeschaffungen Durchführung von Wartungs-, Instandhaltungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an elektrischen Anlagen und Geräten in unseren Gebäuden Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Funktionsfähigkeit der elektrotechnischen Systeme Planung und Umsetzung von technischen Verbesserungen zur Steigerung der Effizienz Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern und Lieferanten Unterstützung bei der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsvorschriften Was Du mitbringen solltest Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Elektrotechnik oder als Elektroniker, Elektroinstallateur oder vergleichbar Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Gebäudetechnik, idealerweise in der Haustechnik Gute Kenntnisse in der Installation und Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen Fähigkeit zur Fehlersuche und Problemlösung Teamfähigkeit und eine selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von vergüteten Bereitschaftsdiensten, wenn erforderlich Darauf kannst Du dich bei uns freuen Einen facettenreichen Job, eingebettet in ein internationales und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld Eine spannende, verantwortungsvolle Position, in der Du viel bewegen kannst Regelmäßige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Einblick in die wissenschaftliche Forschung Regelmäßige Team-Events und Workshops Für Problemlagen jeglicher Art (auch im privaten Umfeld) kannst Du kostenfrei unsere externe Mitarbeitendenberatung nutzen Attraktive Angebote für Mitarbeitende (Corporate Benefits) Ein bezuschusstes Firmenticket/Deutschlandticket 30 Urlaubstage plus zwei zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester Zahlreiche Sportmöglichkeiten (Tennis- und Basketballplatz, Beachvolleyballfeld, Calisthenics-Park) und Teilnahme an Laufveranstaltungen Einen Arbeitsplatz am HPI-Campus in Potsdam-Babelsberg (S-Bhf. Griebnitzsee) mit schneller Verkehrsanbindung nach Berlin Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inkl. Gehaltsvorstellung. Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich über unsere Karriereseite. Wir bitten um Dein Verständnis, dass E-Mail-Bewerbungen oder Lebensläufe, die zur Vorauswahl per E-Mail gesendet werden, nicht berücksichtigt werden. Als Full-Service Umweltdienstleister mit rund 4.800 Mitarbeitern, 120 Standorten und ca. 1.800 Fahrzeugen allein in Deutschland fördert PreZero Deutschland mit einem breiten Leistungsspektrum eine funktionierende Kreislaufwirtschaft, um einen positiven Wandel für die Umwelt und Gesellschaft zu erwirken. Die Leistungen reichen vom Entsorgungsmanagement über Recyclinglösungen bis hin zur effektiven Nachhaltigkeitsberatung. Das Ziel: Nach dem Zero Waste Ansatz alle vermeidbaren Abfälle zu minimieren, während natürliche Ressourcen geschont und Recycling sowie Wiederverwendung maximiert werden. Die PreZero Unternehmensgruppe ist international tätig und Teil der Schwarz Gruppe, die eine der führenden Handelsgruppen in Deutschland sowie Europa ist und zu der auch die Handelsunternehmen Kaufland und Lidl sowie die Schwarz Produktion gehören. Wir brauchen Vordenker und Pragmatiker, die bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, um sich mit neuem Denken und Tatendrang für ein sauberes Morgen einzusetzen – kurz: Wir brauchen dich! Richtig Lust, #PreZeroHero zu werden? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! content.Title: Full Stack Developer (Ruby on Rails / React) — Remote-first, UK at Better Futures Multi Academy Trust
content.MainContent: Full Stack Developer (Ruby on Rails / React) — Remote-first, UK at Better Futures Multi Academy Trust Part-time Remote, United Kingdom £25,200–£30,000 (3 days per week, pro-rata from £42,000–£50,000 FTE) Apply now Share Twitter Facebook LinkedIn Email Most developer roles give you a stack to maintain. This one gives you a product to shape. We are Better Futures Multi-Academy Trust, a group of sixth form colleges based in the Midlands. Inside the Trust, we are building two products that we believe can change how leadership development and student feedback work in education — and beyond. ARC is a 360-degree leadership platform that turns feedback into genuine behavioural change. Swaya is a student feedback app for iOS and Android. Both are live, both have paying clients, and both are at the point where the right developer can help take them from promising to powerful. We are not a startup in a co-working space. We are a startup inside a well-resourced, stable organisation — which means you get the creative freedom and product ownership of early-stage work, alongside the security, benefits, and backing of a public sector employer. It is an unusual combination, and we think it is a genuinely good one. What you will be doing Taking ownership of ARC and Swaya — their development, their quality, their roadmap. Working directly with the founders on product direction. Inheriting a solid Rails and React codebase and making it better. Managing iOS and Android app updates. Solving real UX problems. Shipping things that real users notice. What we are looking for Strong Ruby on Rails experience — production, not just tutorials React frontend skills and genuine care for UI/UX quality Mobile app experience: iOS and Android (React Native, Flutter, or native) Someone who thinks in products, not just tickets Comfortable with ambiguity, honest about what they do not know, and quick to learn UK-based, with the right to work without sponsorship What we offer 0.6 FTE to start, with a clear path to full-time as the products grow Flexible, remote-first working with occasional in-person days in the UK Midlands Public sector pension and holiday entitlement CPD budget and genuine encouragement to develop your skills A front-row seat on two products that are going somewhere — and a role in deciding where How to apply We do not want a standard covering letter. We want you to complete our short application form, which asks specific questions about your experience, your current working situation, and your approach to mobile development. It takes about 30 minutes if you do it properly. The Application can be found in the advert here : https://www.tes.com/jobs/vacancy/full-stack-product-developer-arc-and-swaya-platforms-coventry-2333242 Submit your completed application form through TES or send to [email protected]. Applications close 8.30am Monday 13th July 2026. We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Published 23 days ago • Expires August 16, 2026 12:18

content.Title: Software Engineer, Growth at Fleetio
content.MainContent: Software Engineer, Growth at Fleetio Full-time Remote, United States, Canada, Mexico Apply now Share Twitter Facebook LinkedIn Email A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers Description Fleetio is looking for a product-minded and collaborative Software Engineer to join our Growth Engineering team. Growth Engineering is focused on helping customers realize value from Fleetio as quickly as possible by building thoughtful onboarding experiences, improving product adoption, and experimenting with features that drive long-term engagement. In this role, you'll build features across the product that make it easier for users to discover value, adopt new workflows, and successfully manage their fleets. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Operations, and fellow engineers to turn insights into product improvements and measurable customer outcomes. This is an opportunity to work on a team that values experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning while delivering high-quality software that directly impacts customer growth and retention. This is a remote opportunity open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico. More About Engineering Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture Engineering culture, interview process and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering Fleetio Go overview video: https://www.fleetio.com/go More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features API docs: developer.fleetio.com Test drive Fleetio to get an even better feel for what we're building: https://www.fleetio.com/register Who You Are Our ideal candidate enjoys solving business problems through thoughtful product development and collaborative engineering. You care about building intuitive user experiences, writing clean and maintainable code, and using data to help inform product decisions. You are curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn through experimentation. You enjoy working with cross-functional teammates, are comfortable receiving and giving feedback, and thrive in an environment where you can make meaningful contributions while continuing to grow as an engineer. This role is part of the Engineering department and reports to the Engineering Manager. Your Impact Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Operations, and other Engineers to deliver high-quality product experiences. Design and implement features that improve user onboarding, product adoption, and long-term engagement. Help build experiments that validate product ideas and measure customer impact. Contribute to technical discussions and collaborate on solutions that balance customer value with technical excellence. Deliver well-tested, maintainable, and performant code. Prototype solutions and iterate quickly based on customer feedback and product insights. Participate in code reviews, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture. Your Experience 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. 1+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails. Experience building modern web applications using React and TypeScript. Experience building full-stack web applications and customer-facing features. Understanding of object-oriented programming principles and relational databases such as PostgreSQL. Familiarity with writing efficient database queries and working with application data. Experience with unit testing frameworks. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Be sure to mention "coffee" in your application so we know you actually read this. Considered a Plus Exposure to A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, or feature flagging. Familiarity with product analytics or user behavior tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap, or similar platforms. Experience using customer data to inform product decisions. Experience improving onboarding, activation, or engagement experiences. Project experience with Tailwind CSS. You know a thing or two about the fleet management industry. Benefits Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family) Vision insurance Incentive stock options 401(k) match of 4% PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!) 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid) FSA & HSA options Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid) Community service funds Professional development funds Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend Remote working friendly since 2012 Published 12 days ago • Expires September 11, 2026 18:30

content.MainContent: Talent Acquisition Team Lead Alice 10 active jobs (view) Published: July 22, 2026 Category Operations Recruitment Job Type 1 Full-time Level of education High school Spoken Language needed Hebrew, English Level of Hebrew Fluent Location of job Tel Aviv/ Ramat Gan How many relevant years experience do you require for the role: More than 3 years Description We are looking for a strategic and highly hands-on leader to lead our recruitment team and drive our global hiring efforts. This is a "player-coach" role where you will not only manage the team but actively source and recruit for key positions.you will bridge the gap between business objectives and talent acquisition, ensuring we scale effectively while maintaining a high bar for excellence, positive growth ROI and state- of - the- art innovation in leveraging our hiring processes and experience. We need a proactive self-starter who is a creative problem solver, highly adaptable, and open to continuous changes in a fast-paced environment. You must possess a strong executive presence, allowing you to effectively partner with senior leadership. You are expected to work quickly and accurately, bringing a highly technical mindset and an excellent understanding of data to drive our recruitment forward. We work in a hybrid mode! Key Responsibilities - Actively manage full-cycle recruitment for specialized and niche technical roles, demonstrating a strong hands-on approach to ensure a high-quality candidate experience - Lead and mentor a team of TA & HR Associates, providing professional guidance, performance feedback, and career development support. - Partner with executives and senior hiring managers as a confident, trusted advisor to conduct workforce future planning and align hiring priorities with departmental roadmaps - Develop and execute global recruitment strategies to support rapid organizational growth across multiple regions. - Initiate, implement and optimize AI-driven recruitment tools and automated workflows that best serve Alice’s hiring needs and its cross - business collaboration with stakeholders. - Drive employer branding initiatives to position the company as a top-tier employer in the global technology market. - Apply your technical data expertise to quickly and accurately analyze recruitment data and KPIs to identify bottlenecks and provide actionable insights to leadership. - Lead the hiring-to-onboarding processes and actionable insights with the team, tying the hiring decisions with an effective and successful onboarding experience in the first 90 days that sets up the new joiners for success long-term. About Alice: Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact—whether with each other or with machines. In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection. REQUIREMENTS Must-Have Qualifications - 2+ years of experience in a leadership or team management role within a talent acquisition department. - 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience gained within a global technology organization with a proven willingness and ability to remain deeply hands-on - Strong Executive Presence: Confident, stable, and capable of challenging and guiding C-level executives and senior management with excellent professional expertise. - Highly Technical & Data-Driven: Deep understanding of data analytics, with the ability to build metrics, read dashboards, and translate numbers into fast, accurate, and actionable decisions - Proven track record of working in a fast-paced startup or high-growth technology environment. - Demonstrated experience managing international hiring processes and navigating diverse labor markets. - Proficiency in using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and modern sourcing and AI tools. - Previous experience managing local and global employer branding campaigns or events. - Previous experience leading an annual TA budget. - Creative and out-of-the-box thinker, drive for constant improvement and success, and exceptional critical thinking skills. Nice-to-Have • Experience implementing data-driven recruitment methodologies or advanced HR analytics. • Familiarity with legal and compliance requirements for hiring in multiple international jurisdictions. • Experience with planning long-term employer branding plans beyond the prioritised open position, researching new sourcing and top-of-the-funnel sources, and strategizing how to best position Alice amongst potential candidates globally. • Experience with a design thinking approach on how to unlock issues and best resolve them strategically and practically.
